headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 5, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a pair of victories, taking down the Washington Nationals 7-1 and 11-5. Braxton Ashcraft earned the win in the first game, while Bryan Reynolds, Nick Gonzales, and Evan Sisk contributed to the Pirates' offense in the second game. The Minnesota Twins also had a strong day, defeating the New York Yankees 11-4 behind Josh Bell's 3 home runs and 3 RBIs.

Several teams suffered injuries, including the Milwaukee Brewers, who placed RHP Brandon Woodruff on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Colorado Rockies also lost RHPs Tomoyuki Sugano and Seth Halvorsen to the injured list, while the San Francisco Giants placed LHP Matt Gage on the 15-day injured list with a left elbow strain.

The Cleveland Guardians acquired RHP Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies in a trade, while the Washington Nationals received LHP Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros and RHP Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 7-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Braxton Ashcraft earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 11-4**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a convincing 11-4 victory over the New York Yankees, with Josh Bell leading the charge at the plate. Bell hit 3 home runs, including his 13th of the season, and drove in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out Rangers 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Texas Rangers, with Jack Flaherty pitching 5.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Riley Greene led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Suffer Shutout Loss in Seattle**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays were defeated 11-0 by the Seattle Mariners in a one-sided game. Randy Arozarena led the Blue Jays' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Pull Off Thrilling 10-9 Victory Over Braves**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves in a high-scoring matchup, winning 10-9. Juan Soto and Bo Bichette were among the impact hitters for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, marking a strong performance for the team. Impact hitters for the Pirates included Bryan Reynolds, Nick Gonzales, and Evan Sisk, while the Nationals' Keibert Ruiz and Luis García Jr. also made notable contributions.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Brandon Woodruff Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation.

top_news.title: **Degges Joins Guardians**
top_news.summary: Ryan Degges has been traded to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash. The move comes as the Guardians continue to make roster adjustments.
